findings.title: XSS Vulnerability - Dalgona Challenges
findings.description: Reflected XSS vulnerability on the /page endpoint. The solution input field reflects user input without proper sanitization, allowing execution of arbitrary JavaScript.

reproduction.expected: XSS payload executes and flag is displayed
